} /* Tool chips placement */ .active-tools-chips{ display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; align-items:center; gap:8px; min-height:32px; margin:0 0 8px 0; padding:0; } .tool-chip{ display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:6px 10px; border-radius:999px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10); background:rgba(0,0,0,.30); color:rgba(255,255,255,.90); font-size:11px; letter-spacing:.2px; cursor:pointer; user-select:none; transition:transform .18s ease, filter .18s ease, opacity .18s ease; } .tool-chip:hover{ filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px rgba(165,90,255,.35)); transform:scale(1.02); } .tool-chip svg{ width:16px; height:16px; } .roary-thought-stack3d{ position:absolute; top:var(--rt-thought-stackTop); left:var(--rt-thought-stackLeft); right:var(--rt-thought-stackRight); height:34px; pointer-events:auto; transform:none !important; translate:0 0 !important; z-index:2; perspective:700px; transform-style:preserve-3d; } .roary-thought-card{ position:absolute; inset:0 auto auto 0; width:100%; max-width:540px; padding:8px 10px; border-radius:12px; background:rgba(20,18,28,.62); border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08); box-shadow:0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); transform-style:preserve-3d; will-change:transform,opacity,filter; transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1), opacity .28s ease, filter .28s ease; overflow:hidden; } .roary-thought-card .t-title{ font-weight:700; font-size:11px; } .roary-thought-card:hover{ filter:drop-shadow(0 0 12px rgba(165,90,255,.22)); } /* Hold response disabled (never hide responses) */ .roary-hold-response{opacity:1!important;max-height:none!important;overflow:visible!important;} /* === FINAL OVERRIDES (stability) === */ /* Ensure composer tool chips (icon + title) are visible */ #activeToolsChips{ pointer-events:auto !important;
